WITH per_order_avgs AS (
  SELECT ordersmark, AVG(fillcount) as per_order_avg
  FROM orderexecutions
  WHERE ordersmark IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ordersmark
),
global_avg_val AS (
  SELECT AVG(per_order_avg) as global_avg
  FROM per_order_avgs
),
first_filter AS (
  SELECT poa.ordersmark, poa.per_order_avg, gv.global_avg
  FROM per_order_avgs poa, global_avg_val gv
  WHERE poa.per_order_avg > gv.global_avg
),
first_filter_avg_val AS (
  SELECT AVG(per_order_avg) as filtered_group_avg
  FROM first_filter
),
second_filter AS (
  SELECT ff.ordersmark, ff.per_order_avg, ff.global_avg
  FROM first_filter ff
  WHERE ff.per_order_avg > (SELECT filtered_group_avg FROM first_filter_avg_val)
)
SELECT
  AVG(per_order_avg) as final_avg_fillcount,
  AVG(per_order_avg - global_avg) as avg_margin_over_global,
  AVG(per_order_avg - (SELECT filtered_group_avg FROM first_filter_avg_val)) as avg_margin_over_filtered_group
FROM second_filter
